description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aluthgama, Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District Cad. Map No. 511800 (23/1010)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, cadastral maps, and land registration particulars. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
